title: sqlite3_prepare_v2 return codes are not checked
evidence: src/BookStore.m:37,49,59,68,79 — prepare result ignored; on failure the statement pointer is used without a guard
suggestion: Check the prepare return code and surface a 500 rather than relying on sqlite tolerating a NULL/failed statement

title: GET /books ?author= filter is exact-match only
evidence: src/BookStore.m:47 uses `WHERE author = ?`; README documents this as exact-match
suggestion: Spec only requires an author filter (met); partial/case-insensitive match would be a nice-to-have

title: Single-threaded HTTP server (Connection: close per request)
evidence: src/main.m:67-72 accept loop handles one client at a time
suggestion: Adequate for the task; concurrency would need threading or dispatch queues
